Fianna stood at the alter of Zille. High Priestess of the Temple. Most devout of the Naga, first among the horde. A silver bowl, and a knife, lay upon the alter. She grasped the knife in her hand. Squeezing it tight, there would be much pain and suffering to come. A Naga child, a Royal child had been murdered. Her people seethed with rage, they lusted for blood. In retaliation, many of the High Lords, had begun butchering Lot'dy children. The Heavy Naga, had been more reserved, but Serenity was strained. The city stood on a knifes edge, something needed to be done.

She took the knife, and cut her hand. Allowing the blood to flow into the silver bowl. A blood sacrifice, a prayer for Zille. "Guide me Zille, help us out of this darkness", she said. "Guide us please, use me however you must". She put down the knife, and gestured for an acolyte. A young priestess approached the alter. She carried with her a small brazier. It contained fire. A wonder and a blessing, for those within the Sanctum. It had been their greatest discovery, fire for creatures of the sea. She took the brazier, and dropped it in the bowl, burning her blood, and sealing the prayer.

Zille stepped into her body. Fianna became Zille, and the priestess was gone. In her place stood a goddess. "BRING ME A LEVIATHAN, AND THE VIALS SAOIRSE DELIVERED", her voice boomed around the temple, striking like a whip. Battering the consciousness of her disciples. Zille walked down the alter, taking control. Running down the centre of the temple, was a long pool, 200 feet long, 20 wide, and 6 deep. It was used to bond Naga and Leviathans. A grate opened, and a dark shadow filled the pool, it's spine breaking the surface.

"PEG IT", she commanded. A hundred Naga entered the temple, long spears and hooks in their hands. They began to harpoon the Leviathan. Hooks and spears piercing its body, the beast frenzied. It's own toxins filled the pool, calming the beast. The water black with the blood of the Leviathan. The torn bodies of the slow, littered the temple. Those left alive after the struggle continued, pegging the Leviathan, restraining the beast.

Zille held out her hand, and an acolyte placed a vial within it. She smiled, the Tears of Gaea's heart. A gash opened in the side of the beast, and Zille placed the vial within it. Slowly the potion, would leach into the beast, transforming it over time. "Now to bring in some help" said the goddess. "Cruxius, I need some of your poison", a smile touched her lips.

Then he looked more closely at the girl and saw that Zille had taken residence within the creature. "I suppose I do owe you a favour for granting me the vines in the first place," he chimed.

From the oculus of the temple a strange sight appeared. A gray tree, covered in thorny vines and purple flowers with odd, nearly black berries sank lazily to the chamber floor. It came to rest a few yards from the altar of Zille. It took root in the stones of the altar suddenly, roots digging deep into the stone, and began to sway gently in the turbulent currents stirred by the struggling leviathan. A single flower dislodged itself, a few berries hanging from its stem, and floated lazily through the churning waters, coming to rest, finally, atop the priestesses head.

Zille smiled, "Thank you", she said. She plucked the berries from the air. She held her hand out in front of her, and crushed the berries. The liquid falling into the pool. She transformed the water in the pool, into pure poison. Deadly to the touch. The Leviathan within, caught between to powerful forces. A potion of death, and a potion of life. It would become a terribly twisted creature. Exactly what she needed. "You have been most helpful", she smiled at Cruxius.
